decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [2511_EXLP_001, 2511_EX_001, 2511_EX_002, 2511_EX_003, 2511_EX_105, 2511_PL_101, 2511_PL_102, 2511_PL_103, 2511_PL_104, 2511_PL_105, 2511_PL_106, 2511_PLP_101, Fire safety statement received 02/05/2025
Construction Logistics Plan, construction method statement received 24/06/2025 
Flood risk assessment received 26/06/205 
].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
Reason: In order to ensure that adequate living standards are maintained and to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 5 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public. 
Reason: In order to protect the living conditions of neighbouring residents.

Condition : 6 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
Reason: In order to ensure that adequate living standards are maintained and to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 7 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the '29 Netheravon Road W4 2NA' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes). 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.

Condition : 8 - The windows formed in the secondfloor north elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy
description: Erection of a part second floor rear extension, single storey side and rear extension. Installation of three roof windows and a Juliet balcony. Alterations to the existing windows on the rear elevation. Excavation of existing basement level to enlarge and increase depth with front and rear lightwells. Replacement of existing outbuilding with new timber clad outbuilding.
